name: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) Hybrid Search (BM25 + Dense Vectors)
description: Hybrid search combines sparse keyword search (great for exact names and acronyms) with dense vector search (great for synonyms and concepts). RRF merges both rank lists using: RRF_score = 1/(60 + rank_bm25) + 1/(60 + rank_vec).
prompt:
Hybrid search combines sparse keyword search (great for exact names and acronyms) with dense vector search (great for synonyms and concepts). RRF merges both rank lists using: RRF_score = 1/(60 + rank_bm25) + 1/(60 + rank_vec).

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: doc_id, title, rank_lexical, rank_vector, rrf_score.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Hybrid RRF rank fusion between BM25 lexical score and dense vector cosine similarity
            WITH ranked_lexical AS (
                SELECT 
                    doc_id,
                    title,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lexical_score DESC) AS rank_lexical
                FROM corpus_docs
            ),
            ranked_vector AS (
                SELECT 
                    doc_id,
                    title,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                        ORDER BY array_cosine_similarity(vec, [1.0, 0.0]::FLOAT[2]) DESC
                    ) AS rank_vector
                FROM corpus_docs
            )
            SELECT 
                l.doc_id,
                l.title,
                l.rank_lexical,
                v.rank_vector,
                -- Standard RRF formula with k = 60
                ROUND((1.0 / (60.0 + l.rank_lexical)) + (1.0 / (60.0 + v.rank_vector)), 6) AS rrf_score
            FROM ranked_lexical l
            JOIN ranked_vector v ON l.doc_id = v.doc_id
            ORDER BY rrf_score DESC;
why_it_fails: Adding raw BM25 scores (range 0 to 50+) directly to cosine similarity scores (range 0 to 1) allows BM25 to completely drown out vector relevance.
